name: 网页交互桌面
description: 把桌面软件做成可在线试用的网页。附带可运行的色卡画板，用来练习窗口拖动、撤销、录屏和 PNG 导出。
descriptionEn: Turn a desktop app into a hands-on web demo. The included drawing board demonstrates draggable windows, undo, recording and PNG export.

name: 软件产品全链路交付
description: 从开发、测试到打包上线，按产品类型安排交付。附发布清单和校验工具，涵盖 GitHub Release 附件核对、Windows MSIX 包检查和 Microsoft Store 送审。
descriptionEn: Plan development, testing, packaging and launch. Use the checklists and tools to verify GitHub Release assets, inspect Windows MSIX packages and prepare a Microsoft Store submission.

name: Skill Creator
description: OpenAI 的 Codex Skill 编写指南。用随附的 Python 工具创建 Skill 目录、生成界面信息，并检查说明文件的格式。
descriptionEn: OpenAI’s guide to writing Codex skills. The included Python tools scaffold a skill, generate UI metadata and validate the skill definition.

name: 文档编辑
description: 起草和修订 Word 文档，添加批注，逐页检查最终排版。
descriptionEn: Draft and revise Word documents, add comments and review the layout page by page.

name: PDF 工具
description: 提取 PDF 文本和表格、填写表单，并把页面渲染成图片检查版式。下载包为 Codex 随附版本。
descriptionEn: Extract text and tables, fill PDF forms and render pages for a visual check. The ZIP contains the Codex bundled edition.

name: 演示文稿
description: 把材料整理成可编辑的幻灯片，沿用现有模板，检查图表、讲者备注和导出版式。
descriptionEn: Turn source material into editable slides, reuse a deck template and review charts, speaker notes and exported layouts.

name: 电子表格
description: 用数据创建或更新工作簿，设置公式、图表和格式，导出 Excel 文件或交付到 Google 表格。
descriptionEn: Build or update workbooks with formulas, charts and formatting for Excel files or Google Sheets.

name: Excel 实时编辑
description: 通过 Excel 加载项连接已打开的工作簿，直接读取或修改单元格、公式和图表。
descriptionEn: Connect to an open workbook through the Excel add-in to inspect and update cells, formulas and charts.

name: 图像生成
description: 根据文字或参考图生成、编辑位图，制作产品图、插画和透明背景素材。
descriptionEn: Generate and edit images from a prompt or reference, including product shots, illustrations and transparent cutouts.

name: 交互可视化
description: 在对话中用交互图表、地图和模拟解释数据，调整参数即可比较结果。
descriptionEn: Explore data in a conversation with interactive charts, maps and simulations that respond to changes in inputs.

name: 模板创建
description: 从参考文档、工作簿或幻灯片提取可复用的模板，让后续文件沿用约定的格式与布局。
descriptionEn: Turn a reference document, workbook or slide deck into a reusable template for future files with the same format and layout.

name: Windows 桌面操作
description: 通过 Codex 操作 Windows 应用界面，读取窗口内容，在获准的应用中完成点击和输入。
descriptionEn: Use Codex to inspect Windows application windows, click controls and enter text in the apps you allow.
